title: Data Plane Principal
description: Configured IAM principal bindings MUST map each case-insensitively unique principal email to exactly one non-empty string organization_id. Identity-provider caller allowlists MUST contain non-empty, case-insensitively unique principal emails without surrounding whitespace. Duplicate canonical principals, malformed or whitespace-padded principal entries, and non-string or empty organization identifiers MUST fail closed at startup and request time instead of being overwritten or coerced.
